sentences.en: He checked the durability of the house before buying it.
sentences.zh: 在买房之前，他检查了房子的耐久性。

sentences.en: This machine is inferior to that one in durability.
sentences.zh: 这台机器在耐用性方面不如那台。

sentences.en: Your weapon's durability is very low. You should get it fixed before it breaks.
sentences.zh: 你的武器耐久度很低。在它坏掉之前你应该修理一下。
